evidence_quotes: Bij besluit van 4 mei 2015 heeft de RDW op verzoek van [appellant] de tenaamstelling van het voertuig
rationale: The decision of the Dutch Raad van State concerns an administrative decision by the RDW (Dutch Vehicle Authority) cancelling the registration (tenaamstelling) of a motor vehicle at the appellant's request, which has no substantive connection to water law or water governance.
